questions.answer: Title and images market ESR Paper-Feel detachable magnetic screen protector; listing also says Brand No Brand, while product details say ESR.

Title and details list iPad Pro 11/12.9, iPad 7/8/9, mini 6, Air 4/5; a promotional image uses restrictive 'Only compatible with' for iPad Pro 11 (2018–2022) and Air 4/5. Scope varies between generic listing, selected variant and marketing image. Base iPad 11th A16 2025 not explicitly listed in the inspected capture.
Page explicitly claims paper-feel fine-textured writing/drawing surface; physical performance unverified.

Promotional image includes 'Only compatible with' restriction, a substantive implied exclusion. No direct named incompatibility statement for base iPad 11th A16 was captured, and other listing details conflict in scope. Do not conclusively assert physical incompatibility.

Seller advertises professional drawing surface, note-taking, nib-life benefits and stylus precision; no explicit Apple Pencil statement found in inspected text. Actual stylus/Pencil performance unverified.
Captured selected Air 5/4 variant shows ৳1,567, original ৳1,881, -17%.
No explicit stock label in captured PDF. Buttons and delivery claims visible; actual in-stock state unverified.

Description says Size:12.9, Model Number:Universal, Material:pet, Features:Easy to Install, Quantity:1 Pack, Compatible Brand:For Apple iPad, Brand Name:ESR, origin Mainland China. Marketplace structured specifications say Brand:No Brand. Generic size 12.9 does not align cleanly with selected Air 5/4 option.
Initial Air 5/4 option and ৳1,567 captured. Earlier separate browser report gave alternative Pro 10.5 at ৳1,357; no user PDF post-click capture verifies that interaction.
